name: Collabora Office
_doc: MIRROR, NOT A BUILD. Every other ac_cloud-* dir here holds source we compile. This one holds no source at all, and deliberately: the Collabora Office engine is LibreOffice core, built from Collabora's own Gerrit with an NDK megabuild that pulls its whole external/ tree — hours of compute, a toolchain we do not carry, and a result we could not sign as com.collabora.libreoffice anyway. So ship-cloud-sheets.yml downloads the OFFICIAL APK from Collabora's F-Droid repo, verifies it against the sha256 pinned below, and republishes those exact bytes as our release asset + GHCR artifact so the Constellation AppStore can install and auto-update it like any fleet member. The pin is the whole security story: an unpinned mirror is a supply-chain hole, so a sha mismatch FAILS the job rather than publishing whatever upstream served. Bumping the version means editing upstream.* here (version_name, version_code, apk_name, sha256, size) in one commit — never just the sha.

android._doc_application_id: Upstream's own id, unchanged — these are upstream's bytes, signed with upstream's key. We are a mirror, so we neither rename the package nor re-sign it; installing ours is byte-identical to installing from Collabora's F-Droid repo.

variants._doc: arm64-v8a ONLY. Collabora publishes one ABI per release channel and the pinned index entry declares abis ["arm64-v8a"]; there is no x86_64 artifact to mirror, so there is no second matrix job.

auto_update._doc_require_unmetered_network: 265 MB — the largest artifact in the fleet by an order of magnitude. Unmetered-only so a background auto-update pass cannot burn a mobile data plan.
